notes.title: Celebrate with us first Sprout Valley's anniversary!
notes.content:
[h2]Congratulations Nico! Find out what gifts are waiting in Ostara for the first anniversary of Sprout Valley!
Thank you for this exciting year! Over 140 000 players have found respite at Nico's side on his journey through Ostara – land that is now bustling with life like never before! 

The first anniversary is no small occasion! Therefore, on the occasion of this uncommon event, from today, plenty of additional content awaits you! Check it out for yourself! 💚[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/460df9a7dea2fc42d2e8ff9c3545a6d6105cc6de.png[/img]

So what await you in the anniversary update? From today you can change Nico's appearance and use a new emoji. From 8th of September, you'll be able to play with new pet and Sprays with a lot of drawings!

Do you prefer a Cactus 🌵 or maybe a Panda 🐼? There will be 20 brand-new Nico skins to choose from! Robot, Zombie or Pumpkin? A little hint: You don't have to decide on one you can change them every day at will! 

🎉 🥳 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/aab21e017ea84c0f40d816f5fffc8b235f27d2f9.png[/img]

From September 8th we will welcome Momo, the new adorable sidekick, who has unique skills that you'll love while harvesting! 🌱

Picking all the items from the ground and placing them immediately in their inventory is a snap for him! Collecting resources has never been so enjoyable! 🌿

Or maybe you'll feel that it is time for a change in decoration? A new Sprays tool coming on the anniversary date and will then come to their aid. You can use it to create various patterns on the ground from an extensive library! Is anyone dreaming of a floor decorated with stars? Here you go!

And all the excitement about the new update you can express with a brand new Nico emoji!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/8570d543bf1ce7930bab527491432ee283b86631.png[/img]

[h3] The Skins DLC and emojis are available today as a patch and additional DLC.
Momo Pet and Sprays are going to be available from September 8th both in patch and DLC on Switch eShop and Steam!😍 

Sprout Valley is available on Nintendo eShop and Steam! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/e0fc13fabdfa94a8c1f3e789b89bdc76bb7476ec.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964820/Sprout_Valley/

notes.title: Join another adventure with Sprout Valley at PixElated Festival!
notes.content:
[h2] Nico just finished packing for his next adventure – this time in a pixel style! PixElated Adventures, a celebration of pixel-art games, has just begun on Steam and our little kitten farmer is ready to party! 💚👾[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/8b6182316a8badd9326253b3419d63fe4a39c6c4.png[/img]

[h3]Sprout Valley is a charming farming simulation where players cultivate their island paradise as a kitten – Nico. With this little guy, they embark on a journey where nurturing plants, caring for adorable critters, and uncovering the hidden mysteries of the continent is a day-to-day experience. 
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/3aefecf354e16b43876593f18279d234369bdf7a.png[/img]

[h3]Whether it's rainy or sunny, the world of Ostara will pull players in with its charming residents and exploration-worthy biomes. Adventurers and farmers alike can join Nico on his pixel adventure!

As for the most recent happenings in the world of Ostara – cloud saves are here to stay. Players no longer have to worry about their farms (they’re safe in the cloud) and can enjoy all the new items, biomes, and lovely views that the Summer Patch has to offer.
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/35b3b4e38b044bd4a9990ead3fc5564f2e41ed1c.png[/img]

[h1]PixElated Festival will last until the 5th of August, check it out before it departs! 💚[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964820/Sprout_Valley/

notes.title: Quick update - cloud saves are now available in Sprout Valley!
notes.content:
[h2] Hey guys! Quick news and update for you! Many of you have let it be known that you would like Sprout Valley to support a cloud saving system for safety reasons - we hear you and we act - that's why from now on game supports that system!

You no longer have to worry about your farms, they are safe in the cloud! 

Enjoy!💚[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964820/Sprout_Valley/

notes.title: Start your vacation with Sprout Valley! A hot, huge summer patch update is live!
notes.content:
[h2] Got plans for the summer already? Head to Ostara and check out the gigantic Sprout Valley update! Hot patch update filled with goodes has landed on Steam! Interested what's inside? Read on! 💚[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/ef393bc02e7854aee4ee7fdadd5ab1700886a791.png[/img]

[h3] Can you feel the holiday atmosphere? Visit Ostara as there summer is about to begin in full swing! Enjoy a huge update expanding the world of Sprout Valley with new areas with brand new resources, animals and plants!

Welcome new pets and [Pet Buffs] - an ultimate upgrade to all adorable creatures that can accompany us along the journey through Ostara! it includes a huge variety of buffs that can boost the main character when it comes to Speed, Travel, Luck and Energy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/a156395d25741ad845740e1940e8e1f66e943721.png[/img]

There are also three new large biomes - sand, stone and jungle added! With the new areas, entirely new distinctive animals and plants will be available as well as materials and crafting recipes. 

Players for the first time will have the opportunity to find and take new resources – cactus and bamboo. From them, they will be able to create new furniture, dishes – such as cactus salad and useful devices like cactus juicer and automatic bamboo fish trap.

While staying on the topic of fishes, there will be three new specimens to catch like stone fish (stone biome exclusive), sand fish (sand biome exclusive) and jade (jungle biome exclusive)! [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/4817c3ee27b2a86c7acdce989155420d3be275c2.png[/img]

[h2]A summer update of the game with a myriad of holiday surprises is available now so jump in the game and enjoy! 💚💚💚[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964820/Sprout_Valley/

notes.title: Sprout Valley takes part in Steam Farming Fest 2024! Grab it with -70% off! 💚
notes.content:
[h2] Sprout Valley will germinate at this year's Farming Fest by Steam. Head to Ostera and discover a special surprise prepared for players! Outside the window, spring has already begun in earnest, and in the magical land of Ostera, preparations have begun in advance of the upcoming Farming Fest! [/h2]

Cozy simulator created by Vadzim Liakovich and published by RedDeer.Games is taking part in this year's celebration of agricultural games on the Steam platform, from April 29 to May 6. Discover all that Sprout Valley has to offer, especially since we celebrating Farming Fest, and the new DLC is availible And now the game is discounted by 70%! [/h2]


Sprout Valley is a charming gardening simulation where players cultivate their own lush garden paradise. Players embark on a journey to nurture plants, care for adorable critters, and uncover the mysteries hidden within the sprawling expanse. 

With its blend of simulation and adventure elements, the game provides a serene and enchanting experience, encouraging players to explore, create, and connect with the natural world.

And finally, regarding the previously announced surprise! The developers are happy to announce that Sprout Valley, has received the eagerly awaited "Cows DLC." This exciting addition introduces players to a delightful bovine experience, complete with adorable baby cows and the promise of delicious cheese-making opportunities.

The "Cows DLC" is now available for download on the Nintendo eShop, and Steam inviting players to immerse themselves in the bucolic beauty of Sprout Valley and forge meaningful connections with its newest inhabitants. 

[h2] From the joy of nurturing baby cows to the satisfaction of crafting your dairy delights, there's something for everyone to enjoy in this latest expansion! [/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964820/Sprout_Valley/

notes.title: Winter Holidays update for Sprout Valley is now live!
notes.content:
[h2][b] We're thrilled to announce that new, Winter Holidays update for the game is now live! 
Below you can read the list of exciting things that are included![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/aa77e62798edbf52d1cd226556102ad6418c1eef.png[/img]

Winter Update contains: 
— Terraforming mechanics with new crafting recipes for land and water tiles
— Seedlings to grow your own trees and bushes!
— Light system rework (much more cozy and performant)
— Items descriptions and stacks when picked up
— Ability to remove hoed soil patches
— Ability to drop items in stacks

— "Sprout Valley Arcade" Christmas minigame. Survive 10 waves of slimes invasion to earn awesome prizes! Only available during Christmas event on the arcade machine near your house (must play at least 3 days to see arcade machine appear)!

— Buff initial inventory space to 16 and initial chest space to 32 (only works on new saves)
— Various stability improvements and community reported fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/32512259dac05a9084563dc54e094dfb07b1ae41.png[/img]

[h2][b]❄️❄️❄️ But wait... There's more! ❄️❄️❄️[/b][/h2]
In the following days we'll also push smaller update with new language translations:

— Polish translation
— Portuguese translation
— French translation
— Spanish translation
— German translation
— Bulgarian translation
— Korean translation

[b]...and new, updated, special Main Menu Winter Theme![/b]

HAPPY HOLIDAYS, GUYS! ❤️❤️❤️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964820/Sprout_Valley/

notes.title: Sprout Valley available on DreamHack Beyond Game Awards!
notes.content:
[h2][b] Sprout Valley, the cozy farming sim created by Vadzim Liakhovich and published by RedDeer.Games, has reached the shores of DreamHack Beyond! Many players have joined Nico on his journey in search of friends, mysteries, and most importantly – a place he can call home. [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/3139fb0f434ecc7c7b7b01820f4db34296911b85.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce Sprout Valley’s appearance on DreamHack Beyond and happy to let its you know about some upcoming events that will happen in the game’s near future! Buckle up, buckaroos, it’s time to welcome a new standard of cozy farming games make its way to Steam.

While you hippety-hop through the various islands of Ostara, new seasonal updates will come your way. Sprinkled crafting recipes and event-themed items will start appearing during the upcoming year – they will bring more life to Nico’s little home base and cozy up the game to the max!

And for players who are waiting for something bigger… oh don’t worry, it’s coming. The first Sprout Valley expansion is on its way – we have to be hush-hush about it but know that there are many things to be excited about! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/32512259dac05a9084563dc54e094dfb07b1ae41.png[/img]

For now, know that the community will be seeing more of Ozlo soon enough.

We have also some small Winter Celebration patch for you, which soon will be available on Steam and Nintendo Switch. When? We will let you know in the upcoming days! 

[previewyoutube=HOYuUg_YHEc;full][/previewyoutube]

And finally, a message from Vadzim to Sprout Valley’s community:

“Hello community!

This year was amazing for Sprout Valley. We launched the game and I am seeing a lot good and positive feedback, which warms my heart, since this project is very close to me. We still have a long journey ahead with many cool stuff coming in! Wish you the best holidays and keep being amazing as you are ❤️"

As we celebrate Sprout Valley’s (also known as apple of our eye’s) success, together with Vadzim we wish you the happiest holidays and bountiful harvests!


Sprout Valley is available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, ich.io

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1964820/Sprout_Valley/
